title: Spikes at the squares
plain: Put a fixed bump at every perfect square on the half-line lattice. The spectrum has no absolutely continuous part. Prove the states are localized inside the free band.
math: Let $H=\Delta+\lambda\mathbf 1_{\{m^2:m\ge1\}}$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb N)$, $\lambda\ne0$. Prove that the spectral measure of $\delta_1$ restricted to $(-2,2)$ is pure point.
